framework.name: Agentic Trust Framework (ATF)
framework.publisher: Josh Woodruff (MassiveScale.AI), published through the Cloud Security Alliance
framework.version: 0.9.1 (Public Review Draft); CONFORMANCE.md, which holds the requirement ids, is headed 0.9.0
framework.scope: The 25 core requirements in CONFORMANCE.md (I-1 to R-5). The maturity levels and promotion gates are organisational processes and are not mapped.
notes: ATF governs the organisation that deploys an agent. MoorAI is a third-party runtime guard, so a credit means MoorAI can supply that requirement for an agent it watches, not that MoorAI is ATF conformant.
The CSA announcement (2026-02-02) lists the same 25 requirement titles without ids; the ids come from CONFORMANCE.md.

statusMeaning.covered: a shipped mechanism meets the whole requirement for an agent MoorAI watches
statusMeaning.partial: a shipped mechanism meets part of it; `limit` says which part
statusMeaning.not-covered: a runtime control MoorAI does not provide; `reason` says what is missing
statusMeaning.not-applicable: organisational, not a runtime tool's job

catalog.title: Unique Identifier
catalog.description: Globally unique, immutable identifier for each agent instance

catalog.title: Credential Binding
catalog.description: Agent identity bound to cryptographic credentials

catalog.title: Ownership Chain
catalog.description: Clear documentation of ownership and operational responsibility

catalog.title: Purpose Declaration
catalog.description: Documented intended use and operational scope

catalog.title: Capability Manifest
catalog.description: Machine-readable list of claimed agent capabilities

catalog.title: Structured Logging
catalog.description: All agent actions logged in machine-parseable format

catalog.title: Action Attribution
catalog.description: Every action tied to agent identity and session context

catalog.title: Behavioral Baseline
catalog.description: Established patterns of normal operation for anomaly detection

catalog.title: Anomaly Detection
catalog.description: Identification of deviations from expected behavior

catalog.title: Explainability
catalog.description: Ability to retrieve rationale for agent decisions

catalog.title: Schema Validation
catalog.description: Inputs conform to expected structure and types

catalog.title: Injection Prevention
catalog.description: Detection of prompt injection and adversarial inputs

catalog.title: PII/PHI Protection
catalog.description: Automated detection and masking of sensitive data

catalog.title: Output Validation
catalog.description: Outputs conform to expected structure and content policies

catalog.title: Data Lineage
catalog.description: Tracking of data provenance through the agent pipeline

catalog.title: Resource Allowlist
catalog.description: Explicit enumeration of permitted resources

catalog.title: Action Boundaries
catalog.description: Explicit enumeration of permitted actions

catalog.title: Rate Limiting
catalog.description: Maximum operations per time period

catalog.title: Transaction Limits
catalog.description: Maximum impact per individual action

catalog.title: Blast Radius Containment
catalog.description: Limits on cumulative impact and cascade effects

catalog.title: Circuit Breaker
catalog.description: Automatic halt on repeated failures

catalog.title: Kill Switch
catalog.description: Immediate manual termination capability (<1 second)

catalog.title: Session Revocation
catalog.description: Ability to invalidate all agent sessions

catalog.title: State Rollback
catalog.description: Ability to undo agent actions where possible

catalog.title: Graceful Degradation
catalog.description: Fallback to lower autonomy level on issues

entries.reason: MoorAI labels what it observes (a keyed actor hash per device and user, a keyed session hash) but issues no identity to an agent instance
agent identities are not bound to credentials

entries.limit: the operational scope is declared machine-readably (envelope, workload profiles) and enforced; the intended use is not recorded
the AIBOM inventories each device's agents, models and MCP servers; the tools a server advertises are fingerprinted, not listed
every tool call MoorAI sees (hook, MCP proxy and gateway) is logged content-free; actions outside those surfaces are not
each record carries a keyed actor hash and, for known agent sessions, a keyed session hash; there is no agent identity to tie it to
first-seen tools, paths, servers and hosts per agent, and a learned behavioural baseline; latency and token metrics are not baselined
rule- and baseline-based deviations; no statistical model of latency, tokens or error rates

entries.reason: the agent's rationale is not captured

entries.limit: JSON-RPC and MCP schema validation for messages through the HTTP MCP gateway only
pattern detectors for the listed entity types; masking on the Claude Code hook only
content policy on output (secrets, instruction leakage, rendered-image exfiltration, deceptive links, insecure code); structure is not validated

entries.reason: data provenance through the pipeline is not tracked

entries.limit: MCP servers, model endpoints, hosts and paths written in a call; resources reached at runtime are not seen, and the MCP proxy and gateway do not judge egress rules
per-session call rate and call budget, off by default; the gateway's cool-down counts refusals

entries.reason: the impact of a single action is not bounded

entries.limit: a session risk score across calls, the parent's envelope on sub-agents, and opt-in host isolation; cumulative impact is not measured
halts runaway loops (the same call or cycle with unchanged results) in deny mode; failure counts alone do not trip it
session risk and intent alignment can move calls from allow to ask a person when signals fire; opt-in

rejected.reason: the actor and session hashes identify a device, user and session for correlation; they are not an identity issued to an agent instance
binds a secret to a route, not an identity to a credential
reason codes and moorai-explain explain MoorAI's own verdict, not the agent's decision
session taint is a time window flag on the session, not provenance tracked through the pipeline
approval gates a class of action, not its magnitude
the kill sentinel fires automatically on a kill verdict; there is no manual switch
